answer: A horizon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the karst of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. The glacier of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
